div.head: ECf 8.3
div.ab: Hec predicauit sanctus Augustinus, et hec concessa sunt a rege et confirmata a baronibus et populo.
div.note: Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 632 (November 2026): read from the page images and checked against the scan’s own text layer, differences settled against the page.
Liebermann’s note to the asterisk after “Augustinus” is printed under the ECf retr column; it is given here as well.

div.ab: These things St Augustine preached, and these were granted by the king and confirmed by the barons and the people.

note.seg: Vgl. Gl Zehnt 2ff. 8c; Reichsrat 1b; Augustin Cant. 1. 2. 4. Augustin von Hippo behandelt Zehnten Sermo 9 § 12; 85 § 4 ed. Migne Patrol. 38, c. 82. 89. 522. — Um 600 drang der Zehnt selbst in Frankreich nur vor, nicht durch; Loening Gesch. Dt. Kirchenr. II 677.

Cf. Gl Zehnt 2ff. 8c; Reichsrat 1b; Augustin Cant. 1. 2. 4. Augustine of Hippo treats tithes in Sermo 9 § 12; 85 § 4 ed. Migne Patrol. 38, c. 82. 89. 522. — Around 600 tithe was only advancing, not yet established, even in France; Loening Gesch. Dt. Kirchenr. II 677.
